component.name: openDJ
component.summary: Mix music with decks, stems, effects and DJ controllers

description.p: openDJ is free, open-source DJ software built to be fast and easy to use. It plays your music folders and works with the DJ controllers Mixxx supports.

ul.li: Two or four decks with hot cues, loops, beat jumps, sync, key lock and key shift
Mixer with gain, 3-band EQ, filter, faders, crossfader and headphone cue
Beat-synced effects, a sampler and Automix
Stems: split any track into vocals, drums, bass and melody while you play
A collection with crates, playlists, play history, duplicate and tag clean-up
Imports from VirtualDJ, rekordbox and Mixxx
Accurate beat grids, key detection and harmonic mixing
Ableton Link and fast GPU waveforms

screenshot.caption: Two decks, the mixer and the collection
